purpose: Retained lineage for grounding relational VALUE generation in real GitTables columns. Real values are admitted (not sanitized) because this discrete, content-hashed sampling strategy is pinned by a corpus's strategy_id, so provenance is auditable end-to-end (GitTables snapshot -> this strategy vN -> corpus column -> published corpus vX -> Apache Atlas). RH 2026-07-13: provenance succeeds exclusion.

source.license_posture: public GitHub-derived relational tables; per-value source recorded as <table_sha1>:<column>

segmentation.kind: column-name regex + value-shape validator (the value shape must corroborate the name)
segmentation.per_value_gate: v3: a value enters a pool ONLY if its OWN shape passes the type's validator — the column NAME classifies the type, but each value is individually admitted. (v2 admitted every cleaned value of a name-classified column, so a mostly-name column's stray junk row like 'Incr Critical%' or a single-word place in an org column like 'Guéckédou' leaked in.) Trade-off: fewer but clean pools (organization 255 clean multi-word/suffixed vs the polluted v2 set).
segmentation.placeholder_filter: v3 also rejects registration/scrape placeholders that pass shape but read as nonsense: WHOIS 'REDACTED FOR PRIVACY', 'domains by proxy', 'not disclosed', 'dummy'/'test data'.

identifier.name: id|code|ref|sku|isbn|barcode|serial
identifier.value_validator: alnum code, not a bare float

filter_heuristics.reject: formatting junk [\{}$^~], lorem-ipsum filler, quoted stray junk, unnamed/NA columns

sampling.selection: random sample of source tables (seeded), snapshot_sha1 recorded per run
sampling.per_cell: DETERMINISTIC seed = hash(table_name, column_name, row_ix); reproducible cell values

deferred_types.email: high-risk PII -> sensitivity membrane before injection
deferred_types.phone: high-risk PII -> sensitivity membrane before injection
deferred_types.job_title: residual pool noise pending stronger curation
deferred_types.category: residual pool noise; status/type columns usually satisfied by the ontology enum
deferred_types.temporal: GitTables pool is dateTime-format; the mechanical date-gen is already xsd-correct

round_trip_alignment.kind: SUBTRACTIVE — the agent returns a plausibility CONSTRAINT (num_min/num_max/keep_terms), never a value; the sampler filters the provenance-retained pool to it. Values stay real; the agent only decides which are admissible.
round_trip_alignment.cas_loop: boundary (implausible magnitude/semantic) -> signal (column meaning + candidate real values) -> agent (engine reasons) -> constraint -> membrane (constraint must leave a non-empty admissible pool; else sample the nearest real values, never a mechanical placeholder)
round_trip_alignment.numeric_gate: numeric pools are magnitude-mixed, so GitTables is used for a numeric column ONLY with an aligner constraint (else the mechanical type-gen, which is magnitude-reasonable)

no_silent_fallback.default: gittables=True (rows.py::value_for); the only mechanical values for an INJECTED column come from an explicit opt-out (tests), never a silent transient
no_silent_fallback.availability_boundary: rows.py::require_gittables() — call at corpus-gen entry; HALTS if profiles missing/degenerate (RH: quality can't silently degrade if GitTables is transiently unavailable)
no_silent_fallback.legitimate_mechanical: booleans, dates, and columns claiming no injected type use the type-correct generator (not degradation); coverage is measurable, not silent

pii_governance.policy: provenance-retained, NOT excluded; a sensitivity membrane catches the genuinely-dangerous few (SSN, credentials, medical PII), not the realistic many; email/phone injection gated on that membrane

methods.unified_core: BOTH value paths delegate to the SAME core (rows._gittables_value + rows._semantic_type_of): (1) rows.value_for — the textbook-embedded / lineup tables; (2) entities._cell (via _gt_value) — the FLOW's relational Data Product (the RELEASE corpus). One core → identical realism across ontology-grounding -> relational -> views -> textbooks (RH 2026-07-13: 'same views and values in both'). add_views + render_payload_blocks read THROUGH the construct cells, so real values propagate to views and textbook markdown with no extra work.
methods.run_entry_boundary: flow build_constructs + generate_chapter.main call rows.require_gittables() ONCE before generating (hard halt if profiles missing).
methods.camelcase_norm: rows._semantic_type_of splits camelCase/snake to spaced-lowercase so 'employeeName'/'employee_name' detect identically in both paths.
